name: GTOS (Gold Traders Operating System)
install:
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq python3.12-venv
python3 -m venv /workspace/.venv
/workspace/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
/workspace/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
echo 'export PATH="/workspace/.venv/bin:$PATH"' | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/10-gtos-venv.sh > /dev/null
grep -qs gtos-venv "$HOME/.bashrc" || printf '# gtos-venv\nexport PATH="/workspace/.venv/bin:$PATH"\n' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
